title: Merge through the pull request API and require checks on main
body:
Operator 2026-10-27 (ADR 0014 D21): GitHub Team with a server-side ruleset on `main` of both repositories. Stage one (deletion, non_fast_forward, no bypass) is live in rulesets 25961157 (krn) and 25961159 (krn-codex-skills). GLOBAL `krn ship` still pushes the merge commit directly (fast-forward with lease), which require-PR and required status checks would block. Make `krn ship` merge through `PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{n}/merge` pinned to the reviewed head SHA, keeping the base lease, verifier and delivery record; then add require-PR and the required status checks to both rulesets without bypass. The ruleset change is applied by the lead with the exact rule set read back.
Acceptance: a merge through krn ship lands through the API with the head pinned; a direct push to main and a PR missing a required check are refused by GitHub; both observed on the real repositories.

Observed acceptance (2026-10-27): GLOBAL#467 delivered b145ba37f020224e10c354f178044091503793c6. GLOBAL#469 is the first live new-source API receipt: HTTP200, publication.method=pulls-merge-api/status=merged, published1eb17b8aa86e315fd1d1f1e0e67da5c47f1728dc, exact parents[b145ba37f020224e10c354f178044091503793c6,38cf3c54803d1c1dc38941707c81ec14e454b86b], tree326f3bf47ad1236d9f52920bfa355793eeafc240 and treeMatch=true. Native install apply, installed install check and doctor all exited0 at1eb17b8a; allowUnsealed=false, backup=null; prior sealed2bd304ad retained for rollback. Rulesets25961157(Product) and25961159(GLOBAL) are active with required PR and four required checks each, strict=false, bypass_actors=[]. Product contexts:gate,krn/gate-local,krn/judge-standards,krn/judge-spec; GLOBAL:gate (fast),gate (deep),krn/judge-standards,krn/judge-spec. Real empty-commit direct pushes8423b8fef71ec943cc2e0927b8a75e7568b52a4a(Product) and6858b194e2c19dcd5ac7a8b2f0325d9df505ee21(GLOBAL) both exited1 with GH013, 'Changes must be made through a pull request' and '4 of 4 required status checks are expected'; both main refs stayed unchanged. Real non-draft mergeable PRs with missing checks were refused by pinned-head PUT: GLOBAL#470/head6858b194e2c19dcd5ac7a8b2f0325d9df505ee21 HTTP405 '4 of 4 required status checks have not succeeded: 2 expected'; Product#129/head785027ddc274a345693daf929eebefa8fe4f5ac8 HTTP405 with3 expected. GLOBAL#470 closed unmerged; probe branches/worktrees retired under archive tags. The API atomically pins the head, not the base: the final base re-read narrows the race and exact post-merge parents/tree verification detects divergence. Final closeout#129 must be published through the installed krn ship API after exact-head review/CI/gate:local; its native delivery record is the installed receiver proof, not this unmerged metadata. Receiver artifact manifest SHA256=340c92fbdd8667c032f1e1bdc7d5a6ceb84f57e14a8b8750ba3d85d1895dc517; retained with the final closeout review record.
